idx_branches_terminal_active.name: idx_branches_terminal_active

idx_attendants_clerk_active.name: idx_attendants_clerk_active
idx_attendants_clerk_active.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND clerk_user_id IS NOT NULL

idx_customers_clerk_active.name: idx_customers_clerk_active

chk_cash_ledger_nonneg.name: chk_cash_ledger_nonneg
chk_cash_ledger_nonneg.value: collected >= 0 AND sent >= 0 AND deducted >= 0 AND credit_applied >= 0

idx_orders_active_bag.name: idx_orders_active_bag

chk_gateway_payment_has_reference.name: chk_gateway_payment_has_reference
chk_gateway_payment_has_reference.value: method NOT IN ('mobile_money','card') OR status <> 'paid' OR gateway_reference IS NOT NULL
